status_correction_20260818: Originally reported as a completed formal binding, then corrected to ENGINEERING_ATTESTATION_PASS/HARDENING_PENDING once 6 real gaps were found. All 6 are closed as of 2026-08-19 -- see known_gaps_20260818_resolution below. A second review the same day found the runtime-identity binding and the max_seq_length assertion were both declare-only with no code enforcement at the actual cache-key/encode call sites; both are now closed too -- see the two RESOLVED_20260819B entries below. Materialization still has not started; do not wire this into zero_outcome_census.py without a separate decision to do so.
known_gaps_20260818_resolution: RESOLVED: encoder_binding now includes max_seq_length/truncation_side/dtype as frozen fields (real values read from the live model, not guessed), and identity_sha256 covers them. torch/sentence-transformers versions are deliberately NOT frozen fields (a version bump should change identity, not require editing a constant) -- they are captured live every load as BgeM3RuntimeIdentity, folded into runtime_identity_20260819 below.

RESOLVED: model_safetensors_sha256 is now re-hashed from the actual local Hub cache file (huggingface_hub.scan_cache_dir) at every model load and compared against the declared value -- BgeM3Encoder._load_model raises RuntimeError on any mismatch instead of trusting a copied constant.

RESOLVED: pooling_mode, max_seq_length, truncation_side, and dtype are now asserted against the live loaded model's real config at every load (not just checked once manually outside the module) -- any mismatch raises RuntimeError before encode() can run.

RESOLVED: BgeM3Encoder.encode now sizes batch_size adaptively from text length (4/16/32 tiers) and backs off on CUDA OOM rather than assuming a fixed 32 is always safe -- live-tested with a 5440-character string (well past the >4000-char tier) on this RTX 2070, encoded successfully at batch_size=4.

RESOLVED: EmbeddingSuccessCache.store_success/load now validate vector length (==embedding_dimension), finiteness (no NaN/Inf), and L2 norm (~=1.0 when expect_normalized) -- both write and read paths fail closed; regression tests cover a 2-dim vector, a NaN, an Inf, and an unnormalized vector all being rejected.

RESOLVED_20260819B: EmbeddingCallIdentity previously only bound binding_identity_sha256, with a docstring comment telling callers to 'fold in' BgeM3Encoder.runtime_identity themselves -- no code path actually did. EmbeddingCallIdentity.runtime_identity_sha256 is now a required field (see cache_and_identity below), so a torch/sentence-transformers version bump changes the cache key even when BgeM3Binding is unchanged. Regression test: test_cache_key_changes_when_runtime_identity_changes.

RESOLVED_20260819B: max_seq_length=8192 was only asserted once at model-load time against the model's own config, never checked against actual candidate/document text at encode() time -- sentence-transformers would have silently truncated (truncation_side='right') any longer input instead of raising. BgeM3Encoder.encode now tokenizes every input without truncation and raises RuntimeError before encoding if any text exceeds max_seq_length. Regression test: test_encode_fails_closed_on_text_that_would_be_silently_truncated (real GPU).

STILL OPEN, not an encoder-hardening item: MP/MS/ME query_field=Target.visible_query_text is only correct for the STATIC_ZERO_OUTCOME_CENSUS; a FORMAL_DG_RUNTIME later needs a distinct, dynamic query from the live current-round seeker utterance (see official_visibility_audit.SURFACE_B_NO_PM_IN_HARNESS_NOTE). Documented here as a scope boundary, not something this round's hardening was meant to close.

local_rtx_2070_attestation_20260818.note: This is the first real confirmation this specific local machine (RTX 2070) can run BGE-M3; the existing official RAG attestation ran on an NVIDIA RTX A6000, a different machine, and cannot be read as covering this GPU.

runtime_identity_20260819.captured_by: BgeM3Encoder.runtime_identity, live at model load, not hardcoded

long_text_probe.note: Exercises the >4000-char adaptive batch_size=4 tier, not just the original 2-short-string smoke test.

RS.query_construction: Last query_preceding_turns=6 visible dialogue turns (dialogue-only v2, current-dialogue-excluded), rendered as "speaker: content" lines joined by newline. Already frozen, tested code -- this binding does not redefine it.
RS.document_field_correction_20260818: Originally bound document_field to StrategySourceCard.retrieval_text (source-context only, shared by every accepted unit from the same source card). This was wrong given decision 10's catalog cardinality (one AcceptedAtomicMoveUnit = one independently-retrievable catalog entry): two atomic units from the same source card would get IDENTICAL document embeddings and IDENTICAL similarity scores against any query, so top-1 selection between them would degenerate into an arbitrary card_id tie-break instead of a real semantic choice. Corrected below -- document is now bound per accepted unit, not per source card, matching decision 10's own granularity so retrieval identity, feature identity, and injection identity all align.
RS.document_field: metacom_pm.paper1.rs_atomic_move.catalog.build_atomic_move_retrieval_document: StrategySourceCard.retrieval_text (source context, per source card) concatenated with AcceptedAtomicMoveUnit.rendered_card_text (this specific unit's own rendered content) -- computed separately for every accepted unit, never shared across units from the same source card
RS.document_construction: f"{retrieval_text}\n{rendered_card_text}" per accepted unit. retrieval_text retains the frozen preceding_turns=6 dialogue-only-v2 source-context construction. The executable constructor validates exact source-turn and full dialogue-lineage alignment before emitting a hash-bound document. BGE-M3 embedding/materialization remains pending formal-binding hardening.
RS.consistency_note: Query and the source-context half of the document use the identical construction rule (same window size, same rendering), so a query and a candidate are always comparable text of the same shape. The unit-specific half (rendered_card_text) is what makes two atomic units from one source card produce genuinely different document embeddings.

MP.query_construction: The real officially-asked QA/Summary question text; None for DG (no static current-dialogue state pre-generation, B17.4 -- BGE-M3 similarity is therefore N/A for DG, same convention as the existing lexical-overlap proxy and the explicit_signals detectors).
MP.document_construction: The v6 Qwen compiler's deterministically-rendered candidate text (e.g. "Profile fact [health_condition]: ..."), already hash-bound per accepted unit.
MP.consistency_note: Same query field already used by the existing lexical_candidate_query_jaccard_ge_0_6_proxy in features/zero_outcome_census.py -- BGE-M3 is a drop-in upgrade path for that proxy, not a new text source.

MS.document_construction: Same as MP, for MS-classed accepted units.

ME.document_construction: Same as MP, for ME-classed accepted units.

cache_and_identity.fail_closed_behavior: Re-storing the same identity with a different vector raises RuntimeError rather than silently overwriting; a binding change (revision/pooling/normalization) produces a different binding_identity_sha256, and a torch/sentence-transformers version change produces a different runtime_identity_sha256 (required field as of 2026-08-19B) -- neither ever collides with prior cached vectors under the old identity.
cache_and_identity.no_budget_ledger: Embedding is local GPU compute with no metered per-call cost, unlike the Qwen compilers; no budget/authorization artifact is needed for this binding or for future materialization runs.

not_yet_done: Corpus-wide embedding materialization for RS (12169 source cards) or MP/MS/ME (2745 accepted units) -- this artifact freezes what would be embedded, not the act of embedding it at scale.
Wiring computed cosine similarity into zero_outcome_census.py to replace the lexical-Jaccard/word-overlap proxies -- the proxies remain the active features until this wiring lands and is tested.
NVIDIA NIM tokenizer provider-parity check (RS M2 freeze decision 5's other pending item) -- unrelated to this binding, still open.

Query construction for the RS atomic-move final catalog after the full 12169-card compile is re-run following the verifier fix -- this binding uses StrategySourceCard.retrieval_text, which is compile-independent, but any change to which cards exist does not require re-freezing this binding.
